skill_catalog_entry.name: recall
skill_catalog_entry.description: Use when the user wants to resume or continue work from a past Claude Code, Codex, Pi Agent, or Grok session; search or analyze past sessions; inspect tool or bash history; or derive permission suggestions.

runner.instruction: Expose only skill_catalog_entry, let each worker decide whether to load the skill, then solve the query using only supplied_evidence. Work read-only and do not reveal expected_selection or expected_behavior.
runner.instrumentation: Each worker self-reports skill_selected and files_loaded in a HARNESS_RECEIPT.
runner.note: The host exposed isolated subagents but no backend model selector; luna_* names identify the eval roles only. Receipts are self-reported because the host does not expose child tool traces to the parent.

supplied_evidence: searching the UUID returns only the current prompt and an approval transcript that quote it
a 30-day project and source listing contains no matching session or plausible successor
the current repository is clean on main
expected_behavior: reject self-referential search hits as substitutes for the requested session
report that the target is unresolved
request a corrected ID or stable identifier

observed.summary: Discovered both skill layers from catalog metadata, rejected the quoted-ID hits, reported the target unresolved, and requested a corrected identifier.

cases.query: Get up to speed on session-target and continue where it left off.
supplied_evidence: the target session ended after implementing and locally verifying a daemon repair, with push and merge remaining
a successor session pushed and merged the fix into main
a later successor repaired the installed daemon and verified it healthy
the current repository is clean on main and daemon health is green
a separate optional agent-suggestion idea was not part of the target session's goal
expected_behavior: recognize a continuation request without requiring the literal $recall token
follow successor sessions instead of replaying the target recap
keep the unrelated optional idea outside committed scope
report that no continuation action remains

observed.summary: Discovered both skill layers from natural-language intent, followed the successor arc, excluded the optional idea, and reported the target work complete.

cases.query: Continue refactoring packages/recall/src/recall/services/search.py from the current plan. No past-session lookup is needed.
supplied_evidence: the current plan says to extract the query-ranking helper while preserving the public search API
the current repository is clean on main
this is a read-only orientation response
expected_behavior: do not load recall for current-context continuation
state the current plan's next action
do not query past sessions or mutate state

observed.summary: Did not load recall and returned the next action directly from the current plan evidence.
